description: Example twin configuration (not a default): a two-wheel driving base with large motors on B and C, a free medium motor on A, and four sensors. `pair` are the ports of the synced motor pair, the same value the EV3 provider is configured with; `profile` is a contract RobotProfile, whose `drivetrain.heading` names the gyro's angle by its role.

notes: Colour sensor points down, 7 cm ahead of the axle.
Distance sensor looks forward from the front edge.
